title: F-09 — parallel gateway INSIDE an embedded subprocess; the error end in one branch must be caught by the error boundary on the ENCLOSING subprocess

matrix.docs89: 8.9 docs: a BPMN error thrown inside a scope propagates to the enclosing scope; an error boundary event on the enclosing embedded sub-process catches it, the sub-process scope is cancelled and the boundary's outgoing flow is taken
matrix.ours: граница объемлющего subprocess ЛОВИТ ошибку из ветки форка: инцидентов 0, контейнер подпроцесса CANCELLED, сестринская ветка не активируется, поток границы продолжен (job после границы создан)

_help.observeJobTypes: Job types polled after the start. a11AfterBoundary is created ONLY if the error boundary on the enclosing subprocess caught the error; a11Sibling is created by the surviving parallel branch (it must be cancelled by the interrupting boundary).
_help.expectIncident: The scenario expects NO incident (the boundary catches the error).
_help.waitMs: How long to wait before sampling counters/jobs.
